tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sgyu 'phrul mchog sbyin zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sgyu 'phrul mchog sbyin zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gdod nas yongs grub sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar// sgyu ma ji bzhin sna tshogs gdul bya'i ngor// sgyu 'phrul dra ba rtag tu 'char bdag gang*| |sgyu 'phrul mchog ldan bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// de la 'dir sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la/ slob dpon ni ji skad du/ brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan// bzod ldan drang zhing g.yo sgyu med// gsang sngags rgyud kyi sbyor ba mkhas// des ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// zhes pa'i mtshan nyid de rnams dang ldan pa'i slob dpon la/ slob ma yang ji skad du/ 'jam zhing snyan smra snying rjer ldan// dge ba'i las la mngon par brtson// theg pa che la lhag par dad// rgyun du bla ma la gus shing*// sbyin dang gtong la mngon dga' ba| |slob ma de ni yongs su gzung*// zhes pa'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i slob mas slob dpon la lan gcig nas gsum sogs kyi bar du gsol ba gdab par bya'o// de la slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi rdzas dang*/ yo byad 'di dang 'di sogs 'byor ram mi 'byor dri/ 'byor bar khas len na gnang ba byin la/ slob ma'i rkang mthil du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ gsang bar raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ snying gar las nyon gyi sdig pa'i ngo bo kaṃ nag po rnams gsal bar rkang mthil gyi rlung g.yos me sbar snying ga'i kaṃ bsregs sdig pa thams cad sbyangs par bsam/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du 'bru gsum bkod| 'khor lo can gyi sngags nyer gcig sogs bzlas pas bsrungs/ de nas slob mas yo byad btsal zhing*/ slob dpon gyis sgrub thabs ltar bsnyen pa kha gso gtso bo la 'bum/ 'khor la khri rdzogs par bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/

rjes so// dang po la gnyis/ sa chog dang*/ sta gon no// dang po sa chog la/ sa brtag pa/ sbyang ba/ bslang ba/ gzung ba/ bsrung ba dang lnga'o// dang po sa brtag pa ni/ gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sa der pus nub tsam du brkos par slar sa de nyid blugs pas lhag na dngos grub thob/ ran na 'bring*/ chad na dngos grub med do// yang sa der khung bu mtho gang zlum por brus par ba chus byugs chus bkang*/ rang nyid sems ma yeng bar shar du nye ring 'tsham par phyin/ slar log nas bltas pas khung bu'i chu de lud na rab/ kha dang mnyam pa 'bring*/ dma' na tha ma ste/ de ltar rab ni mchog la/ 'bring ni btang snyoms/ tha ma ni spang bar bya'o// gnyis pa sbyang ba la phyi nang gnyis/ dang po phyi'i sbyang ba la/ las dang bya bas sbyang ba dang*/ sbyin sreg gis sbyang ba'o// dang po las dang bya bas sbyang ba ni/ gzhi der pus nub tsam brkos la sa'i skyon rnams bsal/ de nyid dri zhim po'i chu dang bcas pas khung bu legs par bkang nas der rin chen sna lnga dang*/ 'bru sna lnga la sogs pa bcug la legs par bcag pa'i rnam lnga byug cing nye skor dang bcas par me tog gi gcal bkram/ phyogs mtshams su gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan la sogs pa bsgrengs/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i chus gtor ro// gnyis pa sbyin sreg gis sbyang ba ni/ gzhi der zhi ba'i thab khung du mi rus kyi phye ma la sogs pa'i sbyin sreg gzhung bzhin bya'o// gnyis pa nang gi sbyang ba ni/ nang du gzhol ba'i yid kyis chos nyid kyi sngags/ hūm̐ khaṃ/ brjod la stong pa nyid du bsam// de'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje'i sa gzhir mos la/ oṃ me dī ni badz+rī bha wa badz+ra bhan+dha hūm̐/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pa bslang ba ni/ gzhi der mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams/ rang sgyu 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin la gnas pas/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa sa la brdabs pas/ sa gzhi de gas pa'i ser ga nas/

sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhi ba'i nyams can dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis bum pa 'dzin pa zhig thon nas mdun du gnas par gyur par bsam/ gtor ma sgrub thabs kyi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra i maṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis 'bul/ slar/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ gyis mchod yon dang*| nyer spyod lnga dang rol mo sbyar bas mchod nas/ dpal ldan rdo rje he ru kaḥ /mchod cing sna tshogs rin chen 'dzin// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// zhes lan gsum gyis bslang*/ slar/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud las ni// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas/ lha mos rig pa 'dzin pa khyod ci bde bar gyis shig / ces gnang ba byin pas gzhi de nyid du thim par gyur par bsam/ bzhi pa gzung ba ni/ slob dpon chas dang ldan pa gzhi de'i dbus su rdor dril dang bcas 'dug ste sgyu 'phrul gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pa la/ rgyan dang ldan pa'i slob ma bzhi sogs rdor dril dang bcas phyogs bzhir 'khod pa lha mo bzhi'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gsol ba gdab te/ shar nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ */ rdo rje 'dzin pa las byung ba'i// dkyil 'khor gtso bos bshad du gsol// lho nas/ mtshan nyid thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// nub nas/ zhi ba'i chos mchog las byung ba'i// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog

/dkyil 'khor snying po bshad du gsol// byang nas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med// kun tu bzang po thugs kyi mchog /dkyil 'khor snying po bshad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas slob dpon lha'i nga rgyal gyis 'gyings pa dang bcas/ mig g.yas pa aḥlas zla ba dang g.yon par ṭa las nyi ma/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po khro bo'i tshogs spros pas bgegs gzhom pas rkang mthil du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje gdengs par gsal ba dbang ldan du phyogs pas rdo rje gsor/ hūm̐ ring po brjod cing*/ slar/ deng slob dpon ngas sa phyogs 'dir slob ma'i don du sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi las rtsom gyi/ 'di na gnas pa'i lha/ klu/ gnod sbyin/ dri za/ 'byung po/ sha za/ srin po la sogs pa gang dag gnas pa de rnams 'di ltar dpal he ru ka'i bka' thob nas myur du song zhig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la nga'i rdo rje dang bcas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dis mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ slar yang rdo rje gsor zhing*/ hūm̐ lus ngag sems dang ldan pa yi// bgegs kyi tshogs kun nga la nyon// nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// rdo rje 'bar ba'i kha ṭ+wāṃ gas// sku gsum las byung dgas par bya// gal te bdag tshig las 'gal na// zhig 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// ces brjod cing*/ g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang sogs rdo rje'i 'gros kyis bskor zhing gcag go// lnga pa bsrung ba ni/ bgegs nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i phyir seng ldeng gi phur par tsan+danadamar pos byugs shing me tog dmar po btags pa bcu'am/ gcig bgegs mthar byed du bskyed la/ oṃ ga ga ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nāṃ kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces bcu yod na dbus dang phyogs mtshams/ gcig las med na dbus sam byang shar du btab/ slar yang*/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla bre/ mda'i dra ba phyi rol tu ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo chen po gzhom gzhig dang bral bas yongs su bskor bar gyur par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// gnyis pa sta gon la/ lha/ bum pa/ slob ma/ thig tshon dang bzhi las/ dang po lha sta gon ni/ gzhi der bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa'i dri zhim po'i chus byug cing*/ dbus su sor bcu pa gru bzhi/ phyogs bzhir lha mo bzhi'i gnas su zlum po re re bya/ so sor me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ mchod pas bskor la/ mchod pa sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs/ tshom bu rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte ba dang phyogs bzhir nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la dbus su hrīḥ'am hūm̐ nag po dang*/ oṃ dmar po/ shar gyi 'dab mar hūm̐ sngon po/ lhor swā ser po/ nub tu āḥdamar po/ byang du hā ljang gu rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sgyu 'phrul chen mo rdo rje snying rje'i stobs zhal bzhi zhes pa nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa zhes pa'i bar gyis yab yum dang*/ 'dab ma shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku dang rtsa zhal sngon po zhes pa nas/ 'bar ba'i me 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar gyi lha mo bzhi bskyed/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar tsi ser po nas/ don grub kyis dbu brgyan dbang gi lha rnams lha so so la thim par gyur gyi bar sgrub thabs ltar bsgom/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgyas bsdus gang rung gis mchod/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs chen po// sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan// sha chen rtag tu gsol mdzad pa'i// he ru ka la bdag phyag 'tshal// rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dag

/rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod| |mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje mchog gsum dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// dngos nyid dag pas dri ma med// rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che// mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje dag pa gdon mi za// bsam pa thams cad rab rdzogs byed// sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ bskor ba byas la/ bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pa'i bdug spos lag g.yas su thogs/ g.yon dril bu gsil/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo mchog /rig pa'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal 'dud// khyod rnams la ni mchod pa dang*// slob ma rnams la brtse ba'i phyir// mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid kyis| |dkyil 'khor sang ni bsgrub par 'tshal// bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la// de bas gnang ba mdzad par 'os// 'gro ba'i 'khor lo'i don mdzad pa'i// sangs rgyas mgon po brtser ldan pa'i// byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom dang*// sngags kyi lha gzhan gang lags dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*// gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*// gang dag rdo rje'i spyan mnga' ba'i// sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje che ge mo bdag gis// he ru ka 'byung dkyil 'khor mchog /yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis// 'gro ba dag phyir bdag bsgrub na// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad nas kyang*// dkyil 'khor bar bcas thams cad kyis| |byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol//

zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab cing snyan gsan dbab bo// gnyis pa bum pa sta gon ni/ las bya ba'i bum pa gnyis/ btsa' ba dang*/ nag po/ ra ri med pa dri bzang dang sa dkar gyis byugs// rnam rgyal la pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi ma la thod pa/ 'dab ma shar du rdo rje/ lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gri rnams bri/ las bum la nyi ma'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje bri/ las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brab/ lha'i mdog mthun gyi ras la sogs pas mgrin pa bcings/ rta glang bong bu sogs kyis ma bgrod cing srog chags med pa'i chu gtsang gis sum nyis bkang bar lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga blugs| |me tog dang 'bras bu 'chang ba'i shing gis kha brgyan/ ras dkar dri ma med pa'i steng du me tog bkram pa'i steng du bum pa bzhag /rnam rgyal gyi steng du dung chos sam/ thod pa dri'i chus bkang ba'i steng du rdo rje la me tog gi phreng ba btags pa bzhag /mchod pa bshams la/ bum pa gnyis bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+rūṃ bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa lha'i chu dang bdud rtsi chen pos yongs su gang ba gnyis kyi rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba dang*/ 'dab ma bzhir nyi ma dang de'i gdan re rer gsal ba'i gdan dbus dmar hrīḥ'am hūm̐ dang oṃ/ phyogs bzhir hūm̐ swā āḥhā rnams gsal ba dang*/ bum mtshan gyi sa bon rnams las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sgyu 'phrul chen mo rdo rje snying rje'i stobs zhal bzhi zhes pa nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa zhes pa'i bar dang*/ 'dab ma shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku dang rtsa zhal sngon po zhes pa nas/ 'bar ba'i me 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa

zhes pa'i bar gyis rnam rgyal du lha lnga bskyed/ las bum gyi nang du pad nyi'i gdan la sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang bum mtshan las 'od 'phros/ khams gsum pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs bcom/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sngon po zhal rnam par 'gyur zhing ljags glog ltar 'khyug pa/ spyan gsum pa/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser 'bar ba thod skam lnga'i thod dang*/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ yan lag sbrul gyis dkris shing sham thabs grol ba phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub sgreng ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa/ zhes dang*/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar tsi ser po nas/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la don grub kyis dbu brgyan dbang gi lha so so la thim par gyur par bsam/ sgrub thabs ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin 'od gsal las// sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul lha mo mchod yon ma// sgyu 'phrul bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje mchod yon ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī he ru ka pañtsa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/

de bzhin du/ zhabs bsil dang*/ nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ shrī he ru ka pañtsa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ zhes nang mchod thigs gtor dbul/ bcom ldan sgyu 'phrul chen mo yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dang snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba chen po nas/ lha thams cad zag pa med pa'i bde bas mnyes shing tshim par gyur/ ces gsang mchod 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ rdor dril dang bcas pas/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal bstod// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhan cig skyes pa'i ro snyoms shing*// bdag med ngo bo phyag rgya che// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// byang chub sems mchog rnam par dag /'gyur ba med pa rdo rje'i dbyings// mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// mchog sbyin ma ni bde ba che// mi zad rdo rje nor bu'i dbyings// bla na med pa'i dbang bskur ba// rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// dri med mchog ni rnam par dag /sku gsung thugs ni mtshan ma bral// dri bral ye shes che brnyes pa// pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// rdo rje las ni thogs pa med// rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'gro ba'i mgon// nan tan ye shes cher brnyes pa// sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces grub chen ku ku ri pas sgyu 'phrul lha lnga zhal gzigs dus bstod pa dang*/ las bum gyi lhar/ rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis sprul sku sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// gdug pa 'dul phyir 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can// khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod//

ces bstod/ hūm̐ zhes gzung thag la g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bzung la/ sngags kyi 'od zer gzung thag la 'khril te song bas bum pa'i lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nas byang chub sems kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug bum pa'i chu la 'dres shing*/ lha rnams kyi sku las rang 'dra'i lha rdul phra rab kyi grangs snyed spros pas bum pa gang zhing de thams cad kyi sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bab pas bum pa'i chu dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam/ gtso 'khor gyi sngags sgrub thabs su bshad pa ring thung gang rung rnams ci 'grub dang*/ oṃ badz+rod ka hūm̐/ zhes pa ci 'grub bzla/ slar gzung thag las bum gyi khar spos la/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐/ zhes pa'ang ci 'grub bzla/ mthar rnam rgyal la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sngags pa'i mchod yon dang me tog phul/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha rnams 'dod chags chen pos byang chub sems su zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam/ las bum gyi lhas 'dir ji srid dbang bskur ram/ rab gnas sam/ sbyin sreg la sogs pa gang yin da ེ'i bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du bgegs rnams zlog pa dang*/ bar gcod bsrung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig / ces gsol ba btab/ bum pa gnyis la mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/ bum pa dang sta gon gyi lhar 'jig 'das gnyis kyi gtor ma sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar phul lo// gsum pa slob ma sta gon ni/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor dang bum pa gnyis yol ba sogs kyis bsgribs te mi mthong bar byas la/ sngar shin tu brtags shing rjes su bzung ba'i slob ma rnams khrus bya gos gsar pa gyon/ phyag 'tshal zhing lag tu me tog dang bcas slob dpon gyi mdun du thal sbyar pus btsugs kyis 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug par bya// bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan// gang dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyer// dad pa chen por ldan pa dag

/'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas// blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste// 'di yi 'bras bu gnyer mi bya// gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na// 'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub// ces bsgrags shing de'i don bshad// slob mas/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gros yongs 'khyud pa'i// dpa' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon chen po dgongs su gsol| |byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag phyag 'tshal// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// bdag la byang chub sems kyang stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon sgyu 'phrul chen mor gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od spros/ slob ma la phog pas slob ma 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa rang gi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i nang dhū ti'i lam brgyud yum gyi pad+mar phab pa de nyid sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i sku'i rnam par gyur pa phyir spros/ gral du 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ bu tshur shog cig theg chen gyi// snod ni tshul chen khyod yin pas// sngags kyi spyod tshul cho ga rnams| |khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje che// dus gsum byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun// de dag gis ni gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di'i sgo nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// shākya seng sogs mchog gis kyang*// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pas// drag po chen po bdud kyi sde'i// dpung chen dag kyang 'dis bcom nas// 'jig rten mthun par gshegs nas su// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das| |de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig

/ ces brjod cing don bshad/ slob mas/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du brtsal dang yi rangs pa// sangs rgyas spyan sngar bdag gis su// ma lus so sor bshag par bgyi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyis// sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams tshogs// de la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// sgyu 'phrul gtso bo yab yum dang*// mkha' 'gro'i ma tshogs bcas pa dang*// gsang sngags theg pa bla med pa'i// chos mchog la yang skyabs su mchi/ /dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang*// byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa ltar// de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do| |bdag ni dge ba 'di dag gis// myur du sangs rgyas bsgrub bya ste// sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// bla med gnas la 'god par bgyi// zhes gsum gyis lnga rnam dag bya// slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i mā yā'i dkyil chog rim pa gsal bar/ skabs 'dir rigs lnga'i sdom gzung mdzad pa ltar/ spro na dngos gzhi'i skabs su bshad pa ltar 'dir bya la/ mi spro na grub chen rgyan pas 'dir ma mdzad pas mi dgos so// de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes rtsa sngags kyis bsrung*/ tsan+dan la sogs pa dri'i chus lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa slob ma'i gnas gsum du nye reg bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ slob ma'i spyi bor me tog dang*/ mdun du spos/ mig sngar mar me/ snying khar dri chab/ phyag tu lha bshos/ snyan du rol mo rnams so so'i sngags kyis 'bul/ de nas 'o ma can gyi shing gas chag med pa drang po sor bcu gnyis pa'i tshad la rtse mor me tog btags pa/ gtso bo'i sngags kyis slob ma'i thal mo'i bar du sbyin/ maṇ+ḍal la ba'i rnam lnga dang*/ dris byugs par phyogs mtshams mi 'chol ba'i tshom bu byas pa'i steng du/

slob mas so shing gi rtse mo me tog dang bcas pa sos cung zad 'cha' zhing kha shar du phyogs pas maṇ+ḍal steng du ltos pa med par/ oṃ badz+ra hā sa hā/ zhes dor bas/ cod pan dang bcas pa'i rtse mor rang ngam steng du bltas na mchog gi dngos grub thob/ shar du bltas na dngos grub 'bring*/ mtshams bzhir bltas na zhi sogs 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub brgyad/ 'og tu bltas na sa 'og gi dngos grub thob/ phyi rol du lhung na bgegs sna tshogs pas dngos grub med do| | zhes lung bstan/ de nas dri chu la/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥdharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsā s+ya bi sho dha ya sarba bi kalpa a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes mngon par sngags shing khyor bar byin pa lan gsum 'thung du gzhug pas ngag sbyangs/ de nas yi ge dhīḥ bzlas pa'i ku sha sngas dang*/ hūm̐ bzlas pa stan gyi don du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la sbyin/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i srad bu dmar po mdud pa gsum dang gtso bo'i sngags btab pa bzlas sngags zlos bzhin du dpung pa g.yon par bcing*| de nas spro ba bskyed cing chos bshad pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u duṃ wā ra'i me tog bzhin// rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung srid// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// bla med byed par nus pa yin// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*| |dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul gnas pa la smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas nas ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang gis spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu dri med na// sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi// ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur| |bdag nyid chen po khyod rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa'i// bdag nyid chen po thams cad kyis// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun| |yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin par// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen gyi// legs pa nyid du 'gro bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan| |khyed rnams der ni dong bas na// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur//

zhes brjod cing don bshad/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyis slob ma bsrungs/ bu kye seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis// ku sha'i stan la nyal nas su// nangs par bzhin bzang rnams longs shig /rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa// de kun drang por nga la smros// sang ni nangs par khyed rnams kyis// thar pa chen po'i rang bzhin gyi// grong khyer dam pa mthong bar 'gyur// zhes bsgrags/ slob ma rnams kyis/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor pa la gsol ba btab cing*/ rang rang gi lha la mos pas seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor pa la sngas phyogs la nyal/ slob dpon nang du zhugs te/ slob ma bsrung phyir 'khor lo can gyi sngags bzla zhing gtor ma btang la nyal/ nangs par snga bar slob ma'i rmi lam dris la bzang na gzengs bstod/ ngan na rtsa ba'i sngags bzla ba'am zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o// de nas slob dpon gyis sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor pa la mchod cing bstod nas/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo gnyis brkyang ba rtse sprad pa kha 'og tu phyogs pa spyi bor bzhag ste/ hūm̐ badz+rot+tiṣ+ṭha/ lha sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ ces der mos la bteg /dri'i dkyil 'khor dang mchod gtor bsdu/ bum pa gnyis dben par gdan gyi steng du mchod pa dang bcas bzhugs su gsol/ bzhi pa thig tshon sta gon la gnyis las/ thig gis cha dbye ba dang*/ ye thig gis byin gyis brlabs shing tshon bkye ba'o// dang po las thig gdab pa ni/ ras bal lam/ mi'i skra'am/ rgyus pa la byas pa'i srad bu legs par bkal zhing*/ phra sbom dang 'jur mdud med pa/ dkyil 'khor ji tsam bya ba'i nyis 'gyur la lag pas bzung bde ba/ khrag chen dang sa dkar gyis gsher bas thig chen brgyad btab/ gru bzhir byas pa cha bcu drug tu phye ba la dkyil 'khor rta babs snam bu bzhi'am/ bcu gcig dang ldan pa lag len mthong brgyud dang man ngag ltar gsal zhing ma 'dres par btab/

de rjes sgo nang gi rtsa thig dang thig ro rnams dbye'o// gnyis pa ye thig gis byin gyis rlob cing tshon bkye ba ni/ rin po che sna lnga'am/ 'bras btags pa'i phye ma'am/ mi rus kyi phye ma tshon gyis kha dog bsgyur ba dkar ser dmar ljang sngon po rnams thod pa'i snod so sor blugs pa'i steng du/ sngar las thig gi skabs bshad pa'i rgyu dang tshad de nyid kyi srad bu lnga kha dog lngar bsgyur ba bkod/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las tshon dang srad bu lnga pad nyi'i gdan la tshon dang srad bu dmar po oṃ las sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma sngon po/ hūm̐ las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ swā las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma dkar po/ āḥlas pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu/ hā las sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma rnams/ rgyas par na sgrub thabs kyi mngon rtogs ltar ram/ bsdu na skad cig tsam gyis bskyed/ rang nyid sgyu ma chen mor gsal ba'i mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba 'od 'bar ba/ mig gnyis myur bar bsgril zhing rdzi ma rdeb cing dbab pa 'bar ba'i lta bas/ oṃ āḥbha ga wān sha shwa ta badz+ra sū tra tsi tra me pra yats+tsha swa tsakra sū tra tsi tra na ya hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ sha shwa ta'i gnas su/ ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ rat+na saṃ bha wa/ a mi tā bha/ a mo gha sid+dhi/ zhes bcug pa brjod pas/ phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga'i nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i thugs ka nas/ oṃ hūm̐ swā āḥhā'i yi ge'i rnam pas ye shes kyi thig tshon spyan drangs dam tshig gi thig tshon la thim par gyur par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra tsi tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes ci rigs bzla/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro zhu ba thig tshon so so'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ slob dpon gtso bo dang*/ slob ma bdud rtsi 'khyil par gsal bas ye thig lnga po lhan cig tu brkyangs pa bsgril zhing*/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tā sarba dharmaḥpa ram+ba ra a nu pra wiṣ+ṭa sarba dharmaḥ.āḥhūm̐/

zhes brjod/ de la bdud rtsi lnga'i chus byugs/ dkyil 'khor la las thams cad pas bsang gtor bya/ slob dpon nub nas g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyis thig skud bzung ba'i sne mo slob ma shar du bltas pa'i lag tu btad nas/ dz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥdz+dzaḥ zhes brjod/ slob mas kyang de skad brjod la blangs te lte ba'i thad du bzung nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ sems can don byed dus yin pas// nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs// de dag 'dir gshegs bya ba'i phyir// thig skud sgra yis bskul ba'o// zhes brjod cing nam mkha' dang sa'i tshangs thig dang po gdab pa'i tshul bya/ de bzhin du slob dpon lho dang slob ma byang du gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa dang*/ slob dpon me dang slob ma dbang ldan dang bden bral du gnas pas shar nub kyi rtsa thig dang*/ de nyid nas byang gi rtsa thig kyang gdab/ slob dpon byin za dang slob ma srin por gnas pas lho'i rtsa thig gnyis pa dang*/ slob dpon de nyid dang bden bral du gnas shing*/ slob ma rlung dang dbang ldan du gnas pas zur thig gnyis rnams gdab bo// de nas ye shes kyi thig skud la nyer spyod lngas mchod/

oṃ badz+ra muḥ ye shes kyi thig skud nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs kar zhugs dam tshig pa mi dmigs par gyur par bsam| tshon rnams nyer spyod lngas mchod nas/ rigs lnga zhu nas rdul tshon lnga'i rnam par gyur/ sa la btab pa'i ye thig hūm̐ badz+rot+tiṣ+ṭha zhes pa'i sngags rgyas nam mkhar bteg nas/ chos dbyings 'di ni dag pa ste// sems can khams rnams sgrol byed pa'i// he ru ka dpal rgyal chen gyi// dkyil 'khor snying po bri bar bya// zhes brjod cing lag g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis tshon nag po thogs nas/ dbang ldan nas shar du g.yas skor gyis rtsig pa sor lnga tsam bri/ de'i phyi dkar/ de'i phyi ser/ de'i phyi dmar/ de'i phyi ljang ba rnams phan tshun ma 'byar zhing ya yo med par slob dpon gyis bris pa'i steng du thod pa'am kham phor bkab la bzhag /gzhan rnams bris zin nas de dang sbrel ran pa'i tshe kham phor bsal te tshon pra brtag /sbom pos nad skyed/ phra bas nor 'dzad/ yon pos rnam par sdang ba 'byung*/ chad na bla ma dang slob ma 'chi'o// slob dpon gyis de tsam bris nas mi nus na slob mas kyang 'bri/ kha dog ni pad+ma'i lte ba dkar/ ge sar ser/ 'dab brgyad dmar/ gong ras mdzes tshon/ mu khyud dkar po la rdo rje nag po'i phreng ba/ khyams phyogs mdog /sgo'i g.yas g.yon du gser gyi bum pa re re/ 'dod snam dmar po la phyogs re re'i lha mo'i gzugs gsum thig le zung re/ sgo khyud dang grwa bzhir rdo rje/ rin chen/ rin po che'i pha gu la rin po che kha dog sna tshogs pa/ dra phyed gzhi nag po la dra phyed dkar po nyi zla dril bu g.yer kha sogs 'phyang ba/ shar bu sngon po ril ba mgo thur bstan gyi rnam pa dkar po/ mda' g.yab dkar po la pad+ma phyed pa'i dbyibs/ zur bzhir gdugs dang*/ logs rnams su rgyal mtshan dang ba dan sna tshogs/ rta babs snam bu bzhi pa yin na sa chu me rlung gi snam bu/

mig gsum dang rwa dang rwa rtse rnams phyogs mdog |snam bu bcu gcig pa byed na kha dog gzhan dang mtshungs/ pad+ma/ 'khor lo// gdugs dang*/ 'khor lo'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags ser po dang spre'us bzung ba'i gdugs dkar po/ khyams pad+ma'i 'og gzhi yin pas ljang gu'i mthar re kha dkar po/ pad 'dab so gnyis sna tshogs mdog /dur khrod gzhi nag po la phyogs mtshams brgyad mchod rten/ gzhan dur khrod kyi bkod pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar tshang ba/ rdor ra gzhi dkar rdo rje nag po/ me ri kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba bri/ lha mtshan ni dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la hrīḥ'am/ hūm̐ sngon po'am/ thod pa'am kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /phyogs bzhi'i nyi gdan la/ shar du rdo rje sngon po/ lhor rin po che'i lcug ma ser po/ nub tu pad+ma dkar dmar/ byang du ral gri ljang gu rnams/ yang na lha mo bzhi'i sa bon byas kyang rung ngo*// mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba re re rnam pa legs par bri'o// de nas tshon lhag ma la mchod cing*/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ tshon gyi ye shes pa nam mkha'i rgyal ba lnga'i thugs kar zhugs/ dam tshig pa mi dmigs par gyur par bsam/ de nas bdag nyid he ru ka'i nga rgyal la gnas pas rdo rje gsor/ dril bu gsil/ g.yas brkyang la sogs pa lus kyi sbyor ba/ hūm̐ ring po dang khro bo'i sngags bzla ba ngag gi sbyor ba/ stong pa nyid du nges pa sems kyi sbyor ba ste/ de gsum dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor la g.yas su lan gsum bskor bas bgegs bsal/ me'i phyi rol du dri bzang bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar bas khyab par byugs/ me tog sna tshogs pa'i gcal bkram| gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan bla bre yol ba la sogs pas gnas khang legs par brgyan/ sngar lha gnas byas pa'i bum pa gnyis spos dang rol mos sna drangs te dkyil 'khor la lan gsum g.yas su bskor nas rnam rgyal shar sgo'i thad kyi rdor ra'i nang dang las bum byang shar gyi rdor ra'i nang du bzhag

/de nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas ye thig nam mkhar bteg pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi las thig la bstims/ de rjes mchod yon gyi rdzas bdun dang bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa'i mchod yon shar/ zhal bsil shar lho/ me tog lho/ bdug spos lho nub/ mar me nub/ dri chab nub byang*/ zhal zas byang*/ mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog byang shar dang*/ de dag gi nang du sgos mchod/ spos/ mar me/ lha bshos rnams shar nub tu phyi nang tshar gnyis re/ lho byang du re re rnams las thams cad pas bsangs/ gtso bo'i sngags dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing bshams/ de yang mchod yon dang zhabs bsil gyi snod dung chos dang*/ mdun du bzed zhal re re bzhag /dri chab kyang dung zhal du bshams la bzed zhal mi dgos/ de ltar zin nas thams cad la gu gul gyis bdug go// bum pa gnyis nas chu bsdus pa thod pa'am dung chos su blugs la rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng du bkod/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang dbang gi bya ba'o// dang po dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa ni/ de nas slob dpon he ru ka'i chas dang ldan pas mi ro'am mi lpags kyi gdan la/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor dkyil 'khor la phyogs pas 'dug la/ oṃ badz+roṅghā ṭa sa ma ya pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ yid kyis dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi phye nas nang du zhugs la dbus su 'khod par mos la/ nang mchod byin rlabs nas bzung sngags bzla ba'i bar bdag gi rnal 'byor sgrub thabs ltar rdzogs par bsgom/ de rjes bum pa gnyis bum pa sta gon gyi bar tshang bar bya/ de nas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ zhes brjod pas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba zhes pa nas/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re zhes pa'i bar dang*/

de rjes/ rang nyid sgyu 'phrul chen mo gsal ba'i snying ga nas 'od kyi rig ma spros pa sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mar gyur pa'i yum gyi mkha' hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po zhes pa nas/ rdo rje dang pad+ma bskyod pa'i phaṭa kyi sgras rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum spyan drangs/ yab kyi khar bcug nas zhu ba sgyu 'phrul chen mo yab yum lha mo bzhi dang bcas par gyur pa nam mkha' gang bar spros/ slar bsdus ye shes kyi lha dang 'dres yab kyi dhū ti'i lam brgyud yum gyi pad+mar bab pa phyir spros/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i nang du gnas so sor bzhugs pa ni dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sgyu 'phrul chen mo rdo rje snying rje'i stobs zhal bzhi| phyag bzhi/ zhabs gnyis pa sku dang rtsa zhal bung ba'i mdog lta bu zhes pa nas/ g.yas bskum pas bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa zhes pa'i bar gyis yab yum bskyed/ de rjes/ 'dab ma shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku dang rtsa zhal sngon po zhes pa nas/ 'bar ba'i 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar gyis 'khor rnams bskyed/ yang na/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re zhes pa'i rjes su/ gdan dbus mar thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i thig le mu tig gi mdog ltar 'tsher zhing 'od 'bar ba gsal bar gyur/ dbus kyi thig le de las thig le dkar po bzhi spros pa zhes pa nas/ 'bar ba'i me 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs pa zhes pa'i rjes su glus bskul mi byed par/ dbus kyi thig le de nyid sa bon hrīḥ'am hūm̐ dang*/ oṃ las rnam snang dang de'i rigs rnams zhes pa nas/ g.yas bskum pas bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa'i bar gyis gtso bo yab yum bskyed pa'i rjes su/ yum gyi mkha' hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po zhes pa nas/ rdo rje dang pad+ma bskyed pa'i snyoms 'jug gi bde ba chen po'i ngo bor yab yum zhu ba 'od kyi gong bur gnas pa la/

phyogs bzhi'i lha mo bzhis bcom ldan 'das ma mthong bas lta bar 'dod nas| kye ma/ gnyen mchog rdo rje'i 'od kyi zhes pa nas/ gar mdzod cig /ces zhu ba'i glus bskul ma thag bcom ldan 'das sngon gyi smon lam dang sems can thams cad la thugs yang dag par rjes su brtse ba'i dpal he ru ka rdo rje snying rje'i stobs yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mas 'khyud pa/ yab yum zhal phyag rgyan dang phyag mtshan thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa chu las nya ldang ba ltar skad cig gis gsal la rdzogs par gyur ces gsal btab/ skyed tshul 'di gnyis ka bdag mdun tha mi dad du sgrub pa'i lugs/ grub chen ku ku ri pas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi lugs thun mong ma yin pa yin pas 'dir bris la/ gzhan rgya bod kyi gzhung so sor skyed tshul mang du mchis kyang ma bris so// de nas skyed tshul de gnyis gang byas kyang*/ lha thams cad dpral bar tsi ser po nas/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur gyi bar go cha drug dag go// gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ lcags kyu la sogs pa bzhi'i phyag rgyas/ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥ ṭak+ki hūm̐ hūm̐/ ṭak+ki hūm̐ baṃ/ ṭak+ki hūm̐ hoḥ sta gon gyi lha rnams nam mkhar bzhugs pa bkug /mdun bskyed kyi dam tshig pa so so la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ yab kyi nu ma'i bar du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hrīḥhūm̐ nag po 'bar ba las rdo rje'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu phyogs bcur spros pa ye shes kyi 'khor lor spyan drangs zhes pa nas/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la don grub kyis dbu brgyan dbang gi lha rnams mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo yab yum la thim par gyur ces mos/ de nas mchod pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ rab gtsang rnyog bral lha yi dal 'gro'i rgyun// kun nas rab 'khyil yan lag brgyad ldan pa// yon chab mtha' yas bla na med pa 'dis| |sgyu 'phrul chen mo 'khor bcas bdag gis mchod// oṃ shrī he ru ka pañtsa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/

'dus ma byas kyang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i sku// gzod nas yongs grub mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar ba// gtsang dme spangs kyang bdag cag kun rtog rnams// sbyang phyir zhal bsil gyis ni bsnyen bkur bgyi// ā tsa mā naṃ= zhes chu gnyis dang*/ kha dog kun bkra 'dab brgya lang tsho yang*// 'dzum pa'i ge sar sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston can// char ltar rab 'bab mdzes ma gser gyi mdog /mkha' khyab blos sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// puṣ+pe= a ga ru dang tsan+dan sih+la// ga pur la sogs yongs su sbyar ba'i spos// sprin ltar spro mdzad lha mo in+d+ra'i mdog /mkha' khyab blos sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// dhū pe= rin chen sgron me phyogs kun snang ba'i gzi// nyi zla 'bum yang 'gog pa'i 'od 'bar bas// kun nas gsal mdzad dga' ma byu ru'i mdog /mkha' khyab blos sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// ā lo ke= gur gum ut+pal la sogs dri bsung sman// kun nas sbyar dang yongs su gyur pa yi// dri chab stong gsum ngad ldan dung gi chu// rab tu 'jug mdzad rig ma margad mdog /mkha' khyab blos sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// gan+dhe= ro brgya dang ldan dri dang bcud ldan pa'i// bza' bca' kun 'dzin lha mo chu shel mdog /mkha' khyab blos sprul dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// nai wi d+ye= /zhes nyer spyod lnga dang*/ bla med rdo rje theg pa'i don ston cing*// shes rab mchog gi rjes 'gro rol mo'i sgra// bdud kyi 'khor lo gzhom phyir 'bul lags na// don gyi dbyings la mnga' brnyes 'di bzhes shig /shapad= zhes rol mor bcas pa phul/ slar/ zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rnam gsum gzugs kyi tshogs// gdod nas grub dang byed pos rab bsgrubs pa// gzugs kyi rdo rjer sprul nas dkyil 'khor mchod// gzugs snang don gyi sgyu mar rtogs gyur cig /rū pa= de bzhin gzugs dang*/

rū pa'i gnas su/ sgra/ shapad/ dri/ gan+dhe/ ro/ ra sa/ reg bya/ spar+she sbyar ba'i 'dod yon lnga dang*/ yang*/ gling bzhir dbang byed 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi// srid la 'os pa rin chen kun gyi 'phrul// rtsibs stong sa zlar byas pa'i 'khor lo che// sgyu ma'i rgyal po mnyes phyir bdag gis dbul// tsakra rat+na= gling bzhir dbang byed 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi| |srid la 'os pa rin chen kun gyi 'phrul/ bai ḍūr chen po dgos 'byung dbang gi rgyal// sgyu ma'i rgyal po mnyes phyir bdag gis dbul// ma ṇi= gling bzhir dbang byed 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi// srid la 'os pa rin chen kun gyi 'phrul// mthong bas bde sbyin btsun mo dam pa ni// sgyu ma'i rgyal po mnyes phyir bdag gis dbul// s+t+rī= gling bzhir dbang byed 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi// srid la 'os pa rin chen kun gyi 'phrul// bsam pa tsam shes khyim bdag blon po che// sgyu ma'i rgyal po mnyes phyir bdag gis dbul// gṛ ha pa ti= gling bzhir dbang byed 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi// srid la 'os pa rin chen kun gyi 'phrul// thal kar mche ba drug ldan glang po'i mchog /sgyu ma'i rgyal po mnyes phyir bdag gis dbul// hasti= gling bzhir dbang byed 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi// srid la 'os pa rin chen kun gyi 'phrul// cang shes rlung ltar myur 'gro bzhon pa'i phul// sgyu ma'i rgyal po mnyes phyir bdag gis dbul// tu raṃ ga a shwa= gling bzhir dbang byed 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi// srid la 'os pa rin chen kun gyi 'phrul// phas rgol kun 'joms dpung tshogs bzhi yi dpon// sgyu ma'i rgyal po mnyes phyir bdag gis dbul// pa ri ṇā ya ka= zhes pa rnams phyi'i mchod pa dang*/ bde chen 'khor lo bde ba'i dngos// haṃ yig chu skyes ku mu da// chags bde'i zla zer gyis phye ba'i// me tog sgyu 'phrul lha la dbul// puṣ+paṃ=

longs spyod 'khor lo spyan la sogs// kun brtags gzung 'dzin khams ji snyed// tsaṇ+ḍa lī yis rab bsregs pa'i| |bdug spos sgyu 'phrul lha la dbul// dhū paṃ= chos kyi 'khor lo mi shigs pa'i// thig ler 'byung bzhi'i rlung thim pas// rmongs mun rab 'joms 'od gsal ba'i// snang gsal sgyu 'phrul lha la dbul// dī paṃ= sprul pa'i 'khor lo phyag rgya bzhi'i// sbyor bas nyi ma zla ba'i khams// kun nas 'dres shing rab sbyar ba'i// dri mchog sgyu 'phrul lha la dbul| |gan+dhaṃ= bde skyong 'khor lo'i rjes chags kyi// ka ra ṇa las byung ba'i sgra// gzhom med bde stong nyams brgya'i gdangs// rol mo sgyu 'phrul lha la dbul// shapad= slar sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sbyar ba'i ma da na yi dwags kyi lhung bzed du bskyil ba byin gyis brlabs pa lag g.yas su thogs/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis thigs gtor dbul zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mchod do// phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi dbang phyug /rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gcig pur gyur pa/ drin can sum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grub chen ku ku ri pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhas mchog nā ro pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog chos sku rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog zhe sdang rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog kun dga' rdo rje'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog gzi brjid grags kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

rngog rin chen bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog don grub dpal bzang gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rngog byang chub dpal ba'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhwa dmar ba chos kyi grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mkhan chen shes rab dpal gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum ldan rin chen dpal gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mtshungs med chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang maṅga la sam+pān+na kīrti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī he ru ka badz+ra kā ru ṇa ba lā ya oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ma hā kā lī ye oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba dharma pā lā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba kā ma de wa tā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sarba pa ri wā rā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/

zhes sbyar ba nang mchod/ de nas/ 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal drug cu bzhir mkhas shing*// mthong thos dran pas bde ba kun ster ba'i// phyag rgya rnam lnga'i gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// rdo rje snying rje'i stobs khyod dgyes phyir dbul// rū pa= snyoms par zhugs tshe mi shigs dga' bde'i sgra// phaṭa dang sita la sogs pa 'dod pa'i dbyangs// phyag rgya rnam lnga'i sgra mchog ci mchis pa// rdo rje snying rje'i stobs khyod dgyes phyir dbul| |shapad= mchu dang pad+ma sbyar ba'i ga pur dang*// chags pa'i rdul gyi rang byung dri la sogs// phyag rgya rnam lnga'i dri mchog ci mchis pa// rdo rje snying rje'i stobs khyod dgyes phyir dbul| |gan+dhe= bzhin ras pad+ma'i mchu sgros ro 'dzin gyi// ge sar gzhib las dga' bde sbrang rtsi'i ro// phyag rgya rnam lnga'i ro mchog ci mchis pa// rdo rje snying rje'i stobs khyod dgyes phyir dbul// ra sa= tsum+ba na dang sen mo 'debs pa dang*// 'khyud dang sbyor ba phan tshun nyams dga' reg /phyag rgya rnam lnga'i reg mchog ci mchis pa// rdo rje snying rje'i stobs khyod dgyes phyir dbul// spar+she= 'du shes gsum gyis snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshe// dga' bzhi'i 'gros dang 'pho med bde stong chos// phyag rgya rnam lnga'i chos mchog ci mchis pa// rdo rje snying rje'i stobs khyod dgyes phyir dbul// dharma dhā tu= zhes dang*/ slar yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i spyi bor oṃ nas ge sar ser po can dang*/ yab kyi gsang bar hūm̐ las rdo rje nas/ a nu rā ga yā mi/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje dang pad+ma bskyod cing snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde bas lha thams cad zag pa med pa'i rang bzhin du dgyes shing tshim par bsam pa ni gsang ba'i mchod pa/ slar yang*/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa'i rdzas// 'khor gsum der 'dzin rab brtags pa// gang gis rnam rtog rnam spangs te// mi rtog byang sems rnam sgom zhing*| |lus dang sems ni rnam dag pa// 'di ni don dam mchod pa yin//

zhes don bsam pa ni bla med de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// de nas bstod pa ni/ rdor dril dang bcas pas/ thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid can// thugs rjes sku sprul 'gro don mdzad// sku gsung thugs kyi dbang phyug gtso// he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhal bzhi phyag bzhi spyan gsum mdzes// zhabs gnyis phyed krung gar tshul gyis// pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs// rgyal ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku mdog sngon po cher 'bar ba'i// 'jigs byed mche ba gtsigs pa po// g.yas ser g.yon ljang rgyab zhal dkar// mnyam med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// de bzhin gshegs pa rigs kyi bdag /rigs btsun rig mas mgul nas 'khyud// dbu la rigs kyi bdag po bzhugs| |bde chen sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sgeg dang dpa' byed 'jigs su rung*// drag dang rgod dang 'jigs par byed// snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi// nyams dgu yon tan khyod la 'dud| |nam mkha'i 'od kyis khebs mdzad cing*// 'jigs pa po yang 'jigs par mdzad// phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan// bde gshegs sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// g.yas g.yon dang po mda' dang gzhu// lhag ma thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ 'dzin// mgo phreng brgya phyed do shal byas// mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// dbu skra kham pa gyen du sgreng*// ka pā la lngas dbu la brgyan// na ra stod g.yogs stag lpags mnabs// 'jigs rung khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// dngos po'i rang bzhin kun gyi mchog /sku la mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs// 'gro ba'i don ni mdzad pa po// sku gsum bdag nyid khyod la 'dud// khyod kyi ye shes spyan zur gyis// mi mthun phyogs rnams skrag mdzad cing*// rgyal mtshan dril bu slar gso mdzad// thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku gsum ye shes lnga bdag nyid// bde bar gshegs pa kun gyi gtso// 'gro ba'i mi shes gcod pa po// stong nyid snying po khyod la 'dud| |sangs rgyas byang chub sems rnams dang*// de nyid brtan pa g.yo bcas pa// khams gsum 'di nyid thams cad kyi// bdag nyid chen po khyod la 'dud// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel byed cing*// phun sum tshogs pa kun ster ma// byang chub lam ni ston pa po// ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// bsam med dpe dang bral bas brjod du med// bde chen sku ste mi 'gyur 'dus ma byas// dngos dang dngos med rnam spangs dmigs pa med// bde chen sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// shar phyogs lha mo rdo rje'i rigs// byams pa'i bdag nyid sku mdog sngo// sa khams me long ye shes bdag

/rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// lho phyogs lha mo rin chen rigs// snying rje'i bdag nyid sku mdog ser// chu khams mnyam nyid ye shes bdag /rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// nub phyogs lha mo pad+ma'i rigs// dga' ba'i bdag nyid sku mdog dkar// me khams so sor rtog rang bzhin| |pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// byang phyogs lha mo las kyi rigs// btang snyoms rang bzhin sku mdog ljang*// rlung khams bya ba grub rang bzhin// sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// thams cad zhal bzhi phyag bzhi ma// phyag na rang rang mtshan ma 'dzin// mtshan dang dpe byad sku la rdzogs// rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal bstod// sku las 'od kyi phreng ba 'phro// mi mgo khrag 'dzag do shal byas// zhabs gnyis nyi mar phyed krung bzhugs// 'khor gyi lha mor phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag rgya rnam pa lnga dang ldan// ka pā la lngas dbu la brgyan// sgeg pa la sogs nyams dang ldan// lha mo'i 'khor la phyag 'tshal bstod// rje btsun 'khor dang bcas pa la// bdag gis bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis// sems can kun gyis rje btsun gyi// go 'phang bla med thob par shog / ces bstod/ gtso 'khor gyi sngags rnams yi ge gsum dang spel nas bzla bar slob dpon ku ku ri pas gsungs pa ltar/ oṃ āḥzhes pa'i mthar bzla bya'i sngags bcug pa'i rjes su sbyar ba ci 'grub bzla'o// slar phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ grub na skabs 'dir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya bar gsungs pa ltar dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor bya/ de nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bskul bas bdag bskyed kyi gzhal yas khang lha mo bzhi dang bcas pa gtso bo'i thugs kar thim/ bdag nyid kyang he ru ka dpa' bo gcig pa'i skur gyur par bsam/ gtor ma gtang ba ni/ bsdu na 'jig 'das lhan cig sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar ram/ rgyas par spro na/

nang du 'das pa'i gtor ma dang*/ phyi rol du 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gtang*/ 'dir nye reg /dkyil 'khor bskor ba/ sgo dbye ba/ rdo rje'i shugs kyis 'jug pa/ me tog dbul zhing bslang ba sogs dkyil chog spyi 'gro ltar byed pa bod la lar 'dug kyang*/ slob dpon ku ku ri pa/ nag po spyod pa/ nag po pa/ 'dul ba byin rnams kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog rgya gzhung bzhi gar zur tsam yang mi 'dug pas ma bcug go// de nas bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i phyir/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin// bdag kyang rab tu bsgral slad du// nam mkha'i rdo rjes bdag la stsol// ces lha la gsol ba btab pas dkyil 'khor pas legs par gnang bar mos nas/ khrus bya/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dbang rnams yongs su rdzogs par blangs/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dam tshig gi glus bstod pa ni/ oṃ/ nam mkha' las byung mtshan med phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sgrubs shig /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag sgrubs shig /nyes pa med la rtag pa ste// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags// 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che// bcom ldan de nyid bdag sgrubs shig /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems su bdag sgrubs shig /dngos grub chen po mchog gi mchog /dbang bskur chen po rgyal bas rgyal// grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa// rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag po'i bdag /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa// sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// sems can kun gyi yab nyid de// 'dod chags mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog / ces dam tshig gi glus bstod/

de nas bden pas byin gyis brlabs pa 'di brjod do// shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi// bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa// bden pa de yis mgon khyod kyis// bdag gi 'dod pa skong byed shog /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung ba med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las byung ba dang*| |de bzhin kho na las byung ba// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni// gzugs brnyan gsal bar sems can rnams// dri med thams cad mthong bar shog / ces brjod do// de nas slob ma gzhug pa ni/ lhag gnas byas pa'i slob ma de rnams las bum gyi chus khrus bya/ gos gsar pa gyon/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bsgribs pa'i phyi rol du 'khod nas/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i yon maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ pus mo btsugs/ thal mo sbyar bas/ 'di na 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho la// nyon mongs tshul khrims na kras khyab// las kyi rlung gi rba klong 'khrugs// bdag bying thugs rje'i rgya mtsho kye// mi shes ling tog gis bsgribs mig /nyon mongs dbang du mdzad nas ni// bde dang sdug bsngal 'jigs las skyob// thugs rje'i rgya mtshos bdag skyobs shig / ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ tsak+ṣurbahan+dha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐/ zhes gdong g.yogs dmar po slob ma'i mig la bkab/ a khaṃ bā'i ra hūm̐/ zhes me tog dkar po slob ma'i thal mo'i bar du sbyin/ bla mas slob ma la/ kye/ 'dod pa'i dga' ba khyod su yin// zhes dri/ slob mas/ bdag ni skal bzang bde chen no// zhes lan gdab/ slar bla mas/ thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// rab tu 'jug par khyod spro'am// zhes slar dri/ slob mas/ thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal lags so// zhes lan gdab/ lnga rnam dag ni/ thog med dus nas 'khor ba na// bdag gis sdig pa ci bgyis dang*// bgyid bstsal gang lags de ring bshags// gtso la slar yang sdom par 'tshal// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams dang*// 'gro gzhan dge ba gang bgyis pa// de dag kun la yi rang ste// byang chub tu ni bdag gis bsngo// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// de ring bdag ni skyabs su mchi// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bcad pa dang*// dge ba rnams ni spel ba'i phyir// byang chub sems gnyis bskyed nas su// 'gro rnams bdag gis mgron du gnyer// sangs rgyas gyur nas 'gro ba rnams// ma lus srid mtsho las bsgral bgyi//

zhes gsum gyis thun mong gi sems bskyed/ thun mong ma yin pa sngags su sems bskyed pa ni/ slob mas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ zhes brjod/ brtan phyir/ slob ma'i snying gar hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan par mos la/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje me tog dang bcas de'i snying gar reg nas/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ slob mas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// gtso bo mkha' 'gro mar bcas pa'i// lha rnams kun la phyag 'tshal lo// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// spyir gsang bar gdam pa ni/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje'i ye shes kyis byin gyis brlab par 'gyur gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang chen dam pa 'di/ dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du ma zhugs pa rnams la ni nam yang smra bar mi bya zhing ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// zhes bsgrags/ slob dpon gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// zhes dkyil 'khor par gsol ba btab/ lag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas slob ma'i lag nas khrid de/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes yol ba'i nang du bcug /slob mas thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar la/ oṃ na maḥte hūm̐/ na maḥmi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ zhes slob dpon la phyag bya/ slar dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas thal sbyar gyis/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pū dzopa s+thā nā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ zhes phyag btsal bas mi bskyod pa snying la zhugs par bsam/ lho sgo nas/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pū dzopa s+thā nā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta rat+na saṃ bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/

zhes phyag btsal bas rin 'byung snying gar zhugs par bsam/ nub nas/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pū dzopa s+thā nā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta pad+ma dha ra a bhi ṣiñtsa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ zhes phyag btsal bas 'od dpag med snying gar zhugs par bsam/ byang nas/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pū dzopa s+thā nā ya āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta a mo gha sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ zhes phyag btsal bas don grub snying gar zhugs par bsam/ de nas slob ma shar phyogs su gnas pas lag par me tog dang bcas phyag 'tshal thal sbyar gyis/ dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// bdag la sdom pa rnams kyang stsol| |byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa// slob dpon chen pos bdag la stsol// ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa stsol bar gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis sdom pa bsgrag pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong*// sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams// blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar gyis// byang chub sems gang de rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bshad do// bla ma sangs rgyas dang mnyam pas// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar gyis// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad// rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus gzung*// 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig dang ni sdom pa mchog /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// khyod kyis yang dag gzung bar gyis// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bya// zhes bsgrags/ slob mas de rnams 'dzin 'dod kyi bsam pas/
sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo// he ru ka dpal mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol//

che ge mo zhes bdag de ring nas// bzung ste ji srid byang chub kyi// snying po la ni mchis kyi bar// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por bdag gis gzung*// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spong ngo*// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyid// gnyis su med pa'i tshangs spyod dang*// rang gi dam tshig bsrung bar bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma grol ba ni dgrol bar bgyi// ma bsgral ba ni bsgral bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// de nas phan yon gyi sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos te/ de lta bu'i ye shes ngas bskyed par bya yi/

khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ smras na khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na/ khyod dam tshig rdo rje 'dis mgo bo 'gas par byed do// zhes dang*/ rdo rje snying gar bzhag nas/ oṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' nyid khyod kyi// snying la de ring yang dag zhugs// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes brjod/ de nas phan yon nyes dmigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam bsgrag mna' bsgag pa ni/ rnam rgyal steng gi dri'i chu khar sbyin zhing*/ oṃ a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// ces gong gi sngags brjod cing blud/ slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam bzhag ni/ bu'i lag pa nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas bzung ste/ deng phyin chad khyod kyi rdo rje sems dpa' nga yin gyi/ ngas gang bsgo ba rnams bu khyod kyis bya dgos la/ nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig /byas na ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba chen por ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes bsgo/ ye shes dbab pa ni/ slob mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis rlobs la/ dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ slob ma sgyu 'phrul chen mor gsal ba'i snying gar dbang chen dkyil 'khor rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lte bar hūm̐/ mgrin par chu'i dkyil 'khor bum pas mtshan par paṃ/ spyi bor rlung gi dkyil 'khor ba dan gyis mtshan par ha/ rkang mthil gnyis su rlung dang mes mtshan pa'i dkyil 'khor la dzhaiḥdamar po gsal ba'i rlung gis me sbar ba dang lhan cig me rlung dang dzhaiḥ'i 'od zer drag po rnams slob ma'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad du song bas snying ga'i sa bsros/

mgrin pa'i chu bskol ba sa dkyil la bab pa'i tshe sems dang yul snang thams cad bde stong du thim par bsam/ slob dpon gyis 'gying ba dang bcas rdo rje gsor/ dril bu dkrol/ rol mo'i sgra drag tu sgrog cing*/ oṃ ā we sha ya/ s+t+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya/ tsa la ya/ hūm̐ āḥha dzhaiḥ zhes rnam pa brgyar 'don cing dbab/ gal te des ma phebs na/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs bkug ste bcug /des kyang ma phebs na/ slob ma'i snying gar zla ba la he ru ka yab yum rdo rje dang pad+ma bskyod pa'i bde ba'i sgra dang 'od zer dmar pos lha thams cad bkug /slob ma'i spyi bo la sogs pa gnas thams cad nas zhugs par bsam la sngags dang rol mo bya/ skyes pa grir shi ba dbugs dang 'bral la khad de'i khar bcug la shi nas bton pa'i gu gul/ ra'i spu/ bud med grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i zla mtshan gyis sbags pa'i 'doms dkris/ byi la'i bshang ba/ slob ma rang gi skra sen/ ro'i dri chen rnams yi dwags kyi lhung bzed du ro sol gyi mer bsregs pas bdug na nges par 'bab bo// de yang thugs bab na yongs su shes pa skye/ gsung bab na sngags smra/ sku bab na nam mkhar 'gro'o// slar spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram gtug cing*/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brtan par bya'o// de nas slob dpon gyis/ snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa bzhin// bsod nams gang yin de dag shog /'dis ni dngos grub gang 'grub dang*/ rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// 'di yi bsod nams ci yod las// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog / ces bden pa'i byin rlabs brjod/ slob ma la mig dar gyi 'og nas mig sngar snang ba'i 'od dri ste/ khyod kyi mig lam ji ltar snang*// zhes dri/ des kyang gang mthong smra/

dkar pos zhi ba/ ser pos rgyas pa/ dmar pos dbang*/ ljang gus drag po/ sngon pos las sna tshogs grub pa'i rtags so// de nas slob mas me tog thal mo'i bar du bzung la/ sgyu 'phrul gtso bo yab yum ni// mkha' 'gro mar bcas tshogs la 'dud// bde gshegs snying po'i dkyil 'khor du// rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas// sngon tshe ye shes bsnyen pa'i lha// gang yin de la 'bab gyur cig |pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes ltos pa med par dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dor/ de yang gtso bor bab na mchog /'khor la thun mong*/ lha gnyis kyi bar du lhung na gang la nye ba de/ mnyam na gnyis ka'i dngos grub 'grub/ rtsig pa'i nang du bab na dngos grub phra mo/ lan gsum bskyar yang rdor ra'i phyir lhung na dngos grub shin tu 'grub par dka' bar shes so// slar/ slob dpon gyis/ rin chen me tog la sogs pa// gang la phog pa rigs kyi lha// gtso bo rigs de bsgom na ni// dngos grub 'byung bar the tshom med/ /ces bsgo/ me tog de nyid blangs la/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes brjod cing slob ma'i mgor sbyin/ de nas slob ma'i mig gnyis la oṃ yig 'od 'bar ba re re gsal bas/ oṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' nyid khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ zhes mig dar bsal/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che// me tog gang du lhung gyur pa| |de ni khyod kyi lha yin no// zhes dang*/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer dam pa ni me ri rdo rje'i ra ba la sogs pa bsrung ba'i gur khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rin po che'i gzhal med khang rab tu 'bar shing mdzes pa'i dbus su/

snying po'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa mtshan dang ldan pa/ 'dab ma shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro/ dbus su sangs rgyas mkha' 'gros 'khyud pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sgyu 'phrul chen mo rdo rje snying rje'i stobs rnams nyi ma dang dbugs bral gyi gdan la bzhugs pa ste/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum du mthong ba yin no// zhes brda sprad/ de ltar dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa la rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ slob mas rjes su mthun pa'i yon dang maṇ+ḍal dbul/ phyag byas te/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob phyir rdo rje can// de ltar yon tan 'byung gnas bstsal// de bzhin bdag la'ang de stsol cig /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyid// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du/ snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyed tsam pa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar dang bcas pa mtshan ma spangs pa bris pa'i steng du slob ma bzhag /de nas shis pa'i cho ga bya ste/ slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yon gyi khu tshur gyis yungs kar bzung la rtsa ba'i sngags bzla zhing g.yas kyis g.yas dang*/ g.yon gyis g.yon du lan gnyis bskor zhing me'i nang du dor/ de 'dra ba lan gsum bya/ slar khu tshur du chu bzung nas kyang de ltar bya'o// de nas rtsa sngags brjod la bsrungs/ dri'i chus nye reg bya/ rtsa sngags btab pa'i dri snying ga /me tog mgo/ mar me mig sngar dbul/ spos dkar gyis bdug go// de nas/ slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi ro'i gdan la hrīḥ'am hūm̐ dang*/

oṃ las bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sgyu 'phrul chen mo rdo rje snying rje'i stobs zhal bzhi/ phyag bzhi/ zhabs gnyis pa sku dang rtsa zhal bung ba'i mdog lta bu zhes pa nas/ g.yas bskum pas bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa yab yum de gnyis kyi dpral bar tsi ser po nas/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur ces go cha drug dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa sgrub thabs ltar slob ma gtso bo yab yum du gsal btab/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje thogs/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa// sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin// de yis nye bar bstan pa'i chos rab mi g.yo ba// 'jig rten gsum du grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa// chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin// dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyi sbyin pa'i gnas// tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi// de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin// zhes sogs bkra shis kyi glu nye bar blangs nas/ rnam rgyal dang las bum gyi chu thod pa'am/ dung chos su bsdus pa thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gtor la bkru/ dkyil chog gzhan rnams su chu dbang gcig las ma gsungs kyang*/ 'dir thog mar shis brjod sngon du 'gro ba'i khrus byas pa'i rjes la/ nang gi dbang bskur ba'i ting 'dzin dang bcas rig dbang lnga mdzad pa ni slob dpon ku ku ri pa nyid kyi dkyil chog tu gsal bar gsungs la/

de yang snga ma la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ phyi ma la/ sangs rgyas dag ni sogs bskur tshig kyang so sor mdzad pa lugs 'di'i khyad chos yin par nges mod kyang*/ bod kyi mā yā'i dkyil chog rnams su sngon la chu dbang ma mdzad par rigs dbang lnga spyir btang ltar mdzad pa/ slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi tshig don la cung zad zhib cha ma byung bar sems so// de nas rig dbang lnga'i dang po chu dbang ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi ro'i gdan la hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa rdo rje snying rje'i stobs sku dang rtsa zhal nag po/ zhal lhag ma ser dkar ljang gu/ phyag g.yas gnyis mda' dang thod khrag /g.yon gnyis gzhu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon gyi do shal can phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs can rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa'i dpral bar tsi ser po/ mig la oṃ dkar po/ rna bar āḥdamar po/ sna la khe dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar ra nag po/ slar yang dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan pa'i snying ga'i 'od kyis ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa la dam tshig pa thim gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las rang rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams dbang rdzas kyi lha la thim zhing*/ dbang rdzas kyi lha yab yum snyoms 'jug gi bde bas zhu ba bum pa'i chur gyur par bsam/ slar yang slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

nyer spyod lngas mchod/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis// 'di la dbang bskur rab tu stsol// zhes slob dpon gyis gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi 'od zer chen po las byung ba'i dbang bskur bar dpon slob gnyis kas mos/ slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal bum pa thogs nas/ sangs rgyas dag ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa| |dbang bskur gnang ba chen po sbyin// badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bum chu spyi bor blug cing bkru/ de nas/ nam mkhar spyan drangs pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo rnams slob ma'i ba spu'i khung bu rnams su bcug pas/ lus thams cad bde ba'i rang bzhin du byas nas/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan gyi sbyor bas gnas par gyur par bsam/ des mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin gyi chu'i dbang bskur ba thob| zhe sdang gi dri ma bkrus/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas 'gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ dbu rgyan bsangs sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi ro'i gdan la swā las rin chen dbang phyug rdo rje snying rje'i stobs sku dang rtsa zhal ser po/ zhal lhag ma sngo dkar ljang ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis rin po che'i snye ma dang thod pa/ g.yon gnyis rtse gsum dang ce spyang*/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon gyi do shal can phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs can rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa'i dpral bar tsi ser po/ mig la oṃ dkar po/ rna bar āḥdamar po/ sna la khe dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar ra nag po/ slar yang dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan pa'i snying ga'i 'od kyis ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa la dam tshig pa thim gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las rang rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams dbang rdzas kyi lha la thim zhing*/ dbang rdzas kyi lha yab yum snyoms 'jug gi bde bas zhu ba slob ma'i me tog phog pa'i rigs de nyid gtso bor byas pa'i dbu rgyan du gyur par bsam/ slar yang slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis// 'di la dbang bskur rab tu stsol// zhes slob dpon gyis gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi 'od zer chen po las byung ba'i dbang bskur bar dpon slob gnyis kas mos/ slob dpon gyis dbu rgyan thogs nas/

bdag po'i rtags kyis mtshan pa yi// rtags kyi dam pa cod pan gyis// de ring khyod la dbang bskur bas// 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs byed par shog /oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa swā/ zhes mgor bzhag / ji ltar bltams sogs kyis chu dbang bskur/ de nas/ nam mkhar spyan drangs pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo rnams slob ma'i ba spu'i khung bu rnams su bcug pas/ lus thams cad bde ba'i rang bzhin du byas nas/ rin chen dbang phyug cod pan gyi sbyor bas gnas par gyur par bsam/ des rin chen dbang phyug cod pan gyi dbang bskur thob/ nga rgyal gyi dri ma bkrus/ tshor ba'i phung po gnas 'gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen dbang phyug gi rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las sgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi ro'i gdan la/ āḥlas snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje snying rje'i stobs sku dang rtsa zhal dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs ldan/ zhal lhag ma ser sngo ljang ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang mda'| g.yon gnyis thod pa dang gzhu/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon gyi do shal can phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs can rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa'i dpral bar tsi ser po/ mig la oṃ dkar po/ rna bar āḥdamar po/ sna la khe dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar ra nag po/ slar yang dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan pa'i snying ga'i 'od kyis ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa la dam tshig pa thim gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye ham̐'u/

bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las rang rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams dbang rdzas kyi lha la thim zhing*/ dbang rdzas kyi lha yab yum snyoms 'jug gi bde bas zhu ba rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur par bsam/ slar yang slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis// 'di la dbang bskur rab tu stsol| |zhes slob dpon gyis gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi 'od zer chen po las byung ba'i dbang bskur bar dpon slob gnyis kas mos/ rgyud gzhan rnams su rig dbang gi skabs rdo rje rtse dgu par bzhed kyang*| slob dpon 'di'i dgongs pas/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa thogs la/ sangs rgyas kun gi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rab bsgrub phyir ni rdo rje zung*// ma hā badz+ra hūm̐ āḥ zhes rdo rje slob ma'i gnas gsum du reg cing lag g.yas su sbyin/ ji ltar bltams sogs chu dbang bskur/ de nas/ nam mkhar spyan drangs pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo rnams slob ma'i ba spu'i khung bu rnams su bcug pas/ lus thams cad bde ba'i rang bzhin du byas nas/ snang ba mtha' yas cod pan gyi sbyor bas gnas par gyur par bsam/ des snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba thob/ 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag /'du shes kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ snang ba mtha' yas rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi ro'i gdan la hā las don yod grub pa rdo rje snying rje'i stobs sku dang rtsa zhal ljang gu/

zhal lhag ma ser dkar sngo ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis ral gri dang ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang zhags pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon gyi do shal can phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs can rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa'i dpral bar tsi ser po/ mig la oṃ dkar po/ rna bar āḥdamar po/ sna la khe dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar ra nag po/ slar yang dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan pa'i snying ga'i 'od kyis ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa la dam tshig pa thim gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las rang rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams dbang rdzas kyi lha la thim zhing*/ dbang rdzas kyi lha yab yum snyoms 'jug gi bde bas zhu ba'i dril bur gyur par bsam/ slar yang slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis// 'di la dbang bskur rab tu stsol// zhes slob dpon gyis gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi 'od zer chen po las byung ba'i dbang bskur bar dpon slob gnyis kas mos/ dril bu thogs nas/ shes rab dril bu'i dbang bskur ba// de ring khyod la sbyin par bya// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi| |shes rab chos kyi dbyangs zhes gsungs// ma hā badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa aḥhā/ zhes lag g.yon du sbyin/

slob mas 'khyud tshul bya/ ji ltar bltams sogs chu dbang bskur/ de nas/ nam mkhar spyan drangs pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo rnams slob ma'i ba spu'i khung bu rnams su bcug pas/ lus thams cad bde ba'i rang bzhin du byas nas/ don yod grub pa cod pan gyi sbyor bas gnas par gyur par bsam| des don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang bskur ba thob/ phrag dog gi dri ma bkrus/ 'du byed kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ rdor dril bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi ro'i gdan la hūm̐ las rtag pa'i rdo rje snying rje'i stobs sku dang rtsa zhal sngon po/ zhal lhag ma ser dkar ljang ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang kha ṭ+wāṃ/ g.yon gnyis dril bu dang thod pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang thod rlon gyi do shal can phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs dang stag lpags kyi sham thabs can rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa'i dpral bar tsi ser po/ mig la oṃ dkar po/ rna bar āḥdamar po/ sna la khe dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar ra nag po/ slar yang dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan pa'i snying ga'i 'od kyis ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa la dam tshig pa thim gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhar| oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las rang rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams dbang rdzas kyi lha la thim zhing*/

dbang rdzas kyi lha yab yum snyoms 'jug gi bde bas zhu ba rdo rje dang dril bur gyur par bsam/ slar yang slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyis// 'di la dbang bskur rab tu stsol// zhes slob dpon gyis gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyi 'od zer chen po las byung ba'i dbang bskur bar dpon slob gnyis kas mos/ rdor dril mnyam por slob ma'i spyi bor bzung nas/ gang gang snang ba de dang de// he ru ka dpal bdag nyid gtso// gang phyir chos rnams rnam dag pas// sangs rgyas ye shes rang bzhin nyid// oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal zhes bos nas me tog gang la phog pa de'i rigs kyi ming gdags/ ji ltar bltams sogs chu dbang bskur/ de nas/ nam mkhar spyan drangs pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo rnams slob ma'i ba spu'i khung bu rnams su bcug pas/ lus thams cad bde ba'i rang bzhin du byas nas/ rnam par snang mdzad cod pan gyi sbyor bas gnas par gyur par bsam/ des rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang bskur ba thob/ gti mug gi dri ma bkrus/ gzugs kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad rigs kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ de ltar dbang bskur ba lnga po dag gis rgyud la sogs pa nyan pa dang*/ bshad pa dang*/ sgrub pa'i snod byas pa yin la/ de dag la rig pa'i dbang bskur ba'i sgras kyang brjod par bya ba yin te/ ma rig pa'i gnyen po rig pa'i ngo bo ye shes lnga po rnams sgrub par byed pa'i phyir ro// yang na spyan ma la sogs pa rig ma lnga'i las yin pa dang*/ ma rig pa las bzlog pas na rig pa'i dbang ngo*//

zhes go ba sbyin no// rig dbang 'di rnams la/ grub chen ku ku ri pas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog tu rigs lngar bskyed pa sogs gsal bar ma gsungs kyang*/ nag po pa'i rim pa gsal bar/ rin chen 'byung ldan der bcug nas// zhes sogs rigs lnga kar gsungs pas sbyar ba yin la/ ku ku ri pas nang gi dbang bskur bar/ dbang lha spyan drangs par gsol ba btab pas/ de'i 'od zer las byung ba'i dbang bskur bar gsungs pa tsam las mi 'dug kyang*/ bod kyi mā yā la lar/ dbang lhar gsol ba btab pas/ snyoms 'jug gis zhu ba spyi bo nas rdo rje'i lam du byung ba la dbang bskur/ slar lha'i gzugs kyis nam mkhar gnas pa la mchod pa sogs sbyar 'dug kyang*/ 'dir rgya gzhung gi dgongs pa gang 'dug ma gtogs bod kyi mā yās kha 'gengs ma byas so// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la bzhi/ bum pa/ gsang ba/ shes rab/ tshig dbang ste/ dang po ni/ dbang stegs seng ge la sogs pas bteg pa'i khri la slob ma bkod nas/ slob dpon la yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ phyag 'tshal nas/ bdag dang gzhan gyi don gyi phyir// rdo rje slob dpon dbang bskur ba// thugs rje can khyod bka' drin gyis// de ring bdag la bstsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung zhig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// zhes dam tshig gsum 'dzin pa'i gnang ba byin la/ slar 'dzin du gzhug pa ni/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du bsam la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas| |rtag tu khyod kyis gzung bar bya// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi/ hi hi hi hi hiḥhūm̐/
