zhes lag g.yas su gtad la| de kho na nyid 'di brjod de/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snying po bdag nyid gtso// bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// zhes 'dzin du gzhug /thugs rdo rje'i dam tshig go/ /de nas/ aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu/ rdo rje snyems ma'i rang bzhin du bsam la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror brjod// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// ces lag g.yon du dril bu byin la/ de nyid brjod pa ni/ srid pa rang bzhin dag pa'i phyir// ngo bo nyid kyis gdod nas dag /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' yis// srid pa dam pa mchog tu byed// ces dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa ra ṇa/ pra ra ṇa/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta| sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni pradzñā pā ra mi tā ghaṇ+ṭa pra bha we badz+ra dharma hṛ da yā ni/ san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho hoḥ.a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing dkrol ba ni/ gsung dril bu'i dam tshig go/ /de nas phyag rgya'i dam tshig sbyin pa na ི/ shes rab lo grangs bcu gnyis la// lag gnyis kun tu 'khyud byas te// rdo rje dril bu sbyor ba yis// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod//

ces brda sprad la/ slob ma skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka rdo rje snying rje'i stobs zhal bzhi/ phyag bzhi/ zhabs gnyis pa/ sku dang rtsa zhal bung ba'i mdog lta bu zhes pa nas/ 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ zhes pa'i bar gyis yab gsal btab/ de'i pang du bu mo lo bcu gnyis ma mtshan ldan nam/ yang na yid kyi rig ma/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal bzhi g.yas skor du zhes pa nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa/ zhes pa'i bar gyis yum gsal btab/ yab yum de gnyis kyi dpral bar tsi ser po zhes pa nas/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan mar gyur/ ces pa'i bar gyis go cha drug bcings/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ de nas slob mas rdor dril dang bcas 'khyud tshul byed du gcug la/ yid kyi lus ni brtan pa'i phyir// dam tshig phyag rgya rab tu grags// gang gi lus ni brtan byed pa// de ni phyag rgyar rab tu grags// zhes brda sprad nas/ phyag rgya dang 'khyud pa las rlung kha sbyor gyi reg pa'i bde ba nyams su myong ba de dag gi ngo bo stong pa nyid dang dbyer med pa'i ting nge 'dzin rang rig pa'i ye shes gang yin pa de ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi ngo bo yin no zhes go bar byas la/ brtan phyir bum chu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi ro'i gdan la hrīḥlas mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs rnam pa lnga'i bdag nyid can rdo rje snying rje'i stobs sku dang rtsa zhal nag po/ lhag ma ser dkar ljang gu/ zhes pa nas/ ba spu'i khung bu rnams su bcug pas lus thams cad de'i rang bzhin du byas/ zhes pa'i bar sngar chu dbang gi skabs ltar bum dbang bskur/ de rjes / oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes me tog 'thor/ nyer spyod lngas mchod nas/ dag pa brjod pa ni| de yang phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa 'di ni mtshon byed dpe'i dkyil 'khor kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu yin la/

gzhan ni ji skad du/ yid ni dkyil 'khor dam pa ste| *|sems ni gzhal med khang brtsegs 'phags// zhes gsungs pas/ lus kyi rkang pa bgrad pa rlung*/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ brang rus sa/ sgal mkhar ri rab/ lus gru bzhi gzhal yas khang*/ phung po lnga rgyal ba/ 'byung ba lnga yum/ mig sogs nang gi skye mched sems dpa'/ gzugs sogs phyi'i skye mched sems ma/ nyon mongs pa sogs dang tshigs rtsa rnams khro bo khro mor gdod nas grub la/ de yang rang gi sems nyid gsal ba'i cha nas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor sgyu ma lta bu/ gsal cha nas 'od gsal stong nyid nam mkha' lta bu/ de yang so so tha mi dad pa gsal stong zung 'jug tu gzod nas grub pa de kho na ltar yin lugs shes shing go bar byos shig / ces dag pa mdor bsdus dang*/ rgyas par spro na/ gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid// ces pa nas/ phyed bcas rdo rje'i gar gyis 'gyings// zhes pa'i bar gyi dag pa sgrub thabs ltar brjod cing don rnams bkrol la bshad do// de nas rjes gnang sbyin pa ni/ me tog gcig slob ma'i mgor bzhag la/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas// sras dang bcas pa'i rnam rol cing*// rdo rje snyems ma'i rnal 'byor gyis// dga' ston bde ba'i mchod par gyis// hūm̐ sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'chang*// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya// des ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur// phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no// oṃ/ lus can rnams la dam chos kyi// khyod kyis glu ni blang bar bya// de yis bde gshegs dngos grub ni// myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur// hrīḥ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni// sangs rgyas thams cad chags par byos// sangs rgyas 'dul ba'i phrin las kyis// gar mkhan tshul du sgyur bar gyis// hoḥ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul ba// brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis// lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su// ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis// āḥ

sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor// byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pas// mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yis// bde gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur// bh+rūṃ/ chos kyi mar me legs spar bas// rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru// sems can ma rig ldong ba la// ye shes sgron me sbar bar gyis// pra/ rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas// tshul khrims de bzhin shes rab dang*// rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi// byang chub lus can rnams la bsgos// ga / zhes so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te brjod pa ni mchod pa brgyad kyi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas gser gyi thur ma la bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas pas/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar| |bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i// ling tog rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ zhes mig dbye tshul bya/ me long bstan la/ gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ */ gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*// rang bzhin dag cing bdag med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes byas la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// zhes brjod| hoḥ zhes mda' gzhu gtad la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la rjes su chags par byos shig / ces brjod cing phyogs bzhi dang 'og tu mda' re re 'phen du gzhug / badz+ra he tu māṃ/ zhes 'khor lo rkang pa'i bar du bzhag / oṃ bhā ṣa raṃ/ zhes lag g.yas su dung gtad/ oṃ badz+ra dharma hrīḥ zhes ma hā mā yā'i rgyud kyi glegs bam gtad/ āḥ zhes lag g.yon du dril bu gtad cing des kyang dkrol/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa// tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su// chos kyi dung ni bla med par// dri med kun tu gang bar gyis// sngags spyod tshul gyi cho ga rnams// skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya// rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun kyang*// khyod la rtag tu srung bar mdzad//

ces chos 'chad pa spyi'i rjes gnang sbyin/ de nas rigs so so'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha lugs su byas te/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten khams rnams thams cad du// ji ltar 'dul ba sna tshogs pa'i// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// de bzhin du chos kyi gnas su/ rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ las kyi tshig bcug pa lngas rjes gnang sbyin/ de nas yang*/ zhi rgyas dbang dang gsad pa dang*// dgug skrag bcing dang bskrad pa dang*// dbye dang mnan pa la sogs pa// las de thams cad sgrub par gyis// ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*| |mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste// rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub rnams// de dag ci dgar sgrub par gyis// zhes bya bas rjes su gnang ngo*// de nas slob dpon langs te thub pa'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ g.yon pas snying gar chos gos kyi grwa bzung*/ g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya bstan la ming dbang bskur ba'i lung bstan te/ oṃ/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa ngan 'gro dag las bton// hoḥ che ge mo badz+ra nā ma ta thā ga ta bhurbahu waḥswaḥ zhes dang*/ gang la ngas tshul 'di dang*/ phyag rgya chen po mchog tu gsang ba'i chos 'dis lung bstan pa de la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ bla na med pa'i byang chub chen por lung ston par mdzad de/ sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no// zhes dad pa bskyed/ de nas gsang ba bsgrags te/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de// de bas 'dod la chags bral bar// nam yang bya ba ma yin no// ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐/ de nas slob ma'i spyi bor gdugs dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gsum bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi sgor gdugs dang bcas par/

sngags rnams 'dzin par 'gyur ba yi// slob ma 'di ni phul ba lags// zhes slob ma dkyil 'khor pa la phul/ de nas gdugs gzhan du bzhag la/ slob ma la 'di skad brjod/ de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur// sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur bar// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs// sems can kun la rjes brtse bas| |dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris// khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su// sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor// zhes bsgo// de nas dbugs dbyung ste/ gsang chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor du| |zhugs pa dang ni mthong ba yis// sdig pa kun las rnam grol ste// de ring khyod ni dge bar gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// phyin chad 'chi ba yod min te// mi thub gnod pa yod min pas// cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid dag sdug bsngal las 'das so// rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya dang*// byang chub sems ni spang mi bya// gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis kyang*// sangs rgyas nyid 'gyur the tshom med// dam pa'i chos kyang smad mi bya// nam yang dor bar yongs mi bya// mi shes pa'am rmongs pa la// de nyid bstan par mi bya'o// rdo rje dril bu mi spang zhing*// slob dpon nam yang smad mi bya// sangs rgyas kun dang mtshungs pas na// de la smod byed gang yin pa// des ni rtag tu sdug bsngal 'thob// rang bdag yongs su spangs nas su// dka' thub kyis ni gdung mi bya// ji ltar bde bar bder gnas na// 'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas// khyod ni de ring 'bras bu yod// lha dang dam tshig mnyam 'gyur te// rdo rje sems dpa' dang mtshungs par// rtag tu khyed rnams grol bar 'gyur// zhes dbugs dbyung*/ slob mas phyag byas ste/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi//

zhes khas blangs/ gtang rag dbul/ des ni phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor mthong*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag /dman pa dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ sprul sku'i nus pa 'jog /'bras bu sku rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang ni/ slob mas bza' btung sha chang*/ me tog /spos dang*/ dri/ rgyal mtshan/ dril bu la sogs pa dang*/ rgyud nas gsungs pa ltar bu mo lo bcu gnyis ma/ gzhin bzang mig gi dkyus ring zhing*// gzugs dang lang tshos rnam par brgyan// rgyan rnams kun dang gos bzang dang*// lha rdzas dri yi byug pa can// rnal 'byor gcig gi bya ba goms// rigs kyi bu mo gang yang rung*// bla ma la ni phul byas nas// zhes slob dpon 'dul ba byin gyis gsungs pa lta bu phul nas/ kye/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub zhi ba dga' chen po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// mi phyed phyag rgya rab tu sgrub// rdo rje sbyor ba gcig la gus// bdag nyid chen po khyod ji bzhin// gtso bos bdag ni mdzad du gsol// 'khor ba'i 'dam gyi rgya mtsho ru// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon yol ba'i bar du gnas shing*/ slob ma yol ba'i phyi rol du bzhag /slob dpon sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ phyag rgya khu ba dang ldan pa de nyid dang slob ma'i mig / oṃ tsak+ṣurbahan+dhas bcings/ phyag rgya de nyid skad cig gis yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo zhes pa nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa 'i bar gyis bskyed/ yab yum gnyis kyi dpral bar tsi ser po nas/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur gyi bar gyis go cha drug bgo zhing gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ yum gyis/ kye ma/ gnyen mchog ces pa nas / gar mdzod cig / ces pa'i bar gyi zhu ba'i glus bskul bas/

yum gyi mkha' hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po bh+rūṃ las skyes pa'i ge sar ser po can/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ las skyes pa'i nor bus mtshan pa bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag par bsam/ a nu rā ga yā mi/ zhes snyoms par zhugs shing slob ma'i don du byang sems yum gyi mkhar phab la/ de nyid rang gi g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas thogs la yol ba'i grwa nas bteg ste/ ji ltar bde gshegs thub chen gyis// byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar// de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbang bskur ba// bdag gi sems rgyun 'di yis bkru// bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa/ zhes brjod cing slob ma'i khar sbyin/ des kyang*/ a hoḥsu kha/ zhes brjod cing rtog pa bral bas btung*/ rig mas kyang rang gi mkhar gnas pa g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis thogs pa yol ba bteg ste/ btung ba rin chen 'di yis ni// rdo rje yi ni lus 'grub par// bu khyod kyis ni shes byas la// yid las byung ba'i chu 'thung zhig /bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa/ zhes slob ma'i khar sbyin/ des kyang*/ a hoḥsu kha/ zhes rnam rtog spangs te btung*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes slob ma dang rig ma'i gdong phye/ de nas slob dpon yol ba'i phyir thon nas/ slob ma la/ de ltar myangs pas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gags nas/ bde drod zung 'jug 'bar 'dzag gi rkyen gyis zhu bde lhan skyes thig le gsum gyi ye shes mngon du byas pa ni gsang dbang gi ngo bo yin no// zhes go ba bskyed/ phyag rgya'i bha ga la slob ma ltar bcug pas kyang bde ba bskyed/ slar yang*/ 'di de rdo rje thams cad kyi// dbang bskur ba yi go 'phang mchog /gsang sngags rnams ni thams cad kyi// las mchog rab 'byams 'grub par byed// ces phan yon brjod/ des gsang ba bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mthong*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /steng sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/

longs sku'i nus pa 'jog /'bras bu gsung rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ gtang rag dbul/ gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ rang bzhin slob dpon go 'phang che// bde gshegs rnams kyi dbang bskur ni// sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub pa// de ni sems can dpag med don// brtul zhugs mchog ni khyod drin gyis// ji ltar 'dul bzhin bdag bgyid do// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis phyag rgya mtshan ldan gyi lag pa nas bzung ste/ dga' ster gnas ster bu mo 'di| |sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// zung zhig zung zhig sems dpa' che// bzung nas mchod pa rab tu bya// thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs mi rgya// 'gro ba gsum po 'di yis ni| |de bas khyod kyis nam yang ni// 'di dang 'bral bar mi bya ste// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med// blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba// de la mchog gi dngos grub med//

ces brjod la sbyin/ rig mas/ bshang gci khrag dang khu ba dang*// sha chen la sogs bza' ba dang*// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa| |bu khyod spro bar byed nus sam// zhes slob mar dri/ slob mas/ lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro// khu khrag la sogs bza' ba dang*// bud med rnams la rtag gus shing*// bha ga'i pad+mar 'o bgyi'o| | zhes lan btab/ rig mas lus dang pad+mar dri bzang pos byugs pa bstan cing skra sil bur phab nas/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di// bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan// bde chen phyag rgya chen po ni// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu gnas// blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// ces brjod/ slob ma'i pang du byon pa na/ slob ma skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sgyu 'phrul chen mo rdo rje snying rje'i stobs zhal bzhi/ phyag bzhi/ zhabs gnyis pa/ sku dang rtsa zhal bung ba'i mdog lta bu/ zhes pa nas/ phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od mnga' ba/ zhes pa'i bar gyis gtso bo dang*/ rig ma skad cig gis yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud pa/ zhes pa'i bar gyis yum du bskyed/ yab yum gnyis kyi dpral bar tsi ser po nas/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar gyis go cha drug bcings/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis ye shes pa yab yum spyan drangs/ slob ma yab yum la bstims/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas/ yum gyi mkha' hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po bh+rūṃ las skyes pa'i ge sar ser po can dang*/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje oṃ las skyes pa'i nor bus mtshan pa bu ga phaṭa kyis bkag par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes slob mas brjod cing*/ rig ma la tsum+ba na sngon du 'gro bas 'khyud cing ka ra ṇa brtsam/

de'i tshe/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i zhing du bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i dkyil 'khor kha dog dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i slob ma yab yum snyoms 'jug gi mdzad pa mthong bas chags pas mar gyi zar bu ltar skad cig gis zhu bar gyur pa dbang bskur ba'i gnas gsum mdzad nas slob ma'i lus la zhugs/ phyi'i lha mo rnams kyis/ bkra shis gang zhig dga' ldan lha yi gzhal yas khang gi ni// snying po nas ni 'gro la phan phyir 'dir gshegs las byung dang*// dbang por bcas dang lha yi de bzhin gshegs pas bskor ba yi// bkra shis des kyang de ring khyod la zhi bar byed gyur cig / ces bkra shis kyi glu dang*/ kye ma/ skal ba bzang po zhes pa'i ca co dang*/ gar dang*/ glu dang*/ sil snyan gyi sgra dang*/ dri bzang po bgos pa'i gos dang*/ tsan+dan gyi phye ma 'thor zhing rab tu shis pa'i las byed par bsam/ slob dpon gyis/ rmongs pa gti mug bdag nyid sbyor// gti mug dga' ma dang ldan pa// gti mug rgyun gyi dbang bskur bas// gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'gyur// sdang la zhe sdang bdag nyid sbyor// zhe sdang dga' ma dang ldan pa// zhe sdang rgyun gyi dbang bskur bas// zhe sdang rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'gyur// chags la 'dod chags bdag nyid sbyor// 'dod chags dga' ma dang ldan pa// 'dod chags rgyun gyi dbang bskur bas// 'dod chags rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'gyur// shes rab ye shes bdag nyid sbyor// rdo rje dga' ma dang ldan pa// ye shes rgyun gyi dbang bskur bas// shes rab ye shes rang bzhin 'gyur// zhes brjod/ slob mas snyoms 'jug gi dga' ba brtsam pa'i tshe/ byang sems zhu ba mgrin par dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral/ gsang bar lhan skyes/ rdo rje'i rtse mor son pas na hūm̐ zhes gyen du drangs pa'i tshe/

lte bar dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ mgrin par dga' bral/ spyi bor lhan skyes ngos bzung*/ de yang 'dzag med du bya bar gdam pa ni/ thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min// de phyir rig pa 'di ni mchog |gnyis su med pa'i chos kun ni// gnyis kyi dngos po mtshon 'gyur ba// de phyir khyod kyis rtag tu ni// 'khor bar bral bar mi bya'o// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med// rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa// de la dngos grub mchog med do// zhes dang*/ de ltar lus thams cad bde bas khyab cing dga' bral gyi mtha'i lhan skyes kyi dus skad cig ma der/ bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes bsal bzhag dang bral ba de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi ngo bo yin no// slar/ sangs rgyas la sogs kun thob pa// de ltar byang chub spyod sogs dang*// dge ba tshul gzhan gyis kyang min// bdag po'i dam tshig bsrung bar bya// rtag tu sdom pa bskyang bar bya// bza' ba sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// bsrung ba 'di las dam tshig gzhan// dkon mchog 'jig bsad bud med kun// gzhan las len dang ngag gi rgyun// rnal 'byor rgyud du bshad pa gang*// de dag cho ga bzhin bsrung bya// zhes smras/ mig dar bsal/ des ni kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /'og sgo sngags kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ chos sku'i nus pa 'jog /'bras bu thugs rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ yon dang gtang rag dbul lo// bzhi pa tshig dbang ni/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar bstsal ba ltar// bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/ tshig la sogs pa brjod pa'i yul las 'das pa'i bde stong gnyis med kyi ye shes rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa ni/

dbang gsum pa'i dus kyi dpe'i lhan skyes nyams su myong ba'i de nyid myu gur byas nas bsgoms pas don gyi lhan skyes 'bras bu mchog thob par bya ba ni/ rgyud las/ chos rnams rang bzhin 'od gsal ba// gdod nas dag cing rnyog pa med// thabs brjod pa yis de la ni// rang byung ye shes lnga ldan 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa de nyid yin la/ de'i thabs brjod pa zhes pa'i thabs ni/ brjod pa'i rim pa nyams su blang ba yin te/ de'i tshul ni/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po dang*/ slob dpon su dza ya shrī bha dras mdzad pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag las/ sangs rgyas rjes dran sbyor ba yis// chos ni rjes su dran par bsgom| |chos rjes dran pa'i sbyor ba yis// chos kyi skur ni rang nyid 'gyur// dbus na gsal byed rnam par shes// ye shes mchog ni shes rnams kyis// shin tu sgom pa goms pa las| |'bar bar 'di ni the tshom med// snying la rtag tu gnas pa yi// thig le gcig tu yi ge med// skyes bu de ni bsgoms gyur na// ye shes skye bar 'gyur ba'i mchog /ces sogs gsungs la/ de lta bu bsgom pa'i man ngag dpyis phyin pa ni slob dpon gyi ngag la rag las te/ de nyid las/ gang phyir shin tu gsang bas na// de nyid bdag gis gsal ma byas| |des ni bla ma yang dag par// mnyes byas yang dag 'dod pa bslang*// zhes gsungs la/ man ngag de lta bu bsgoms pas yun ji tsam na mchog 'grub pa yang*/ de nyid las/ zla drug tsam gyis nges par ni// rnal 'byor can gyis nyer bsten na// rnal 'byor chen po 'di gsal 'gyur// zhes kyang gsungs pas de ltar nyams su blang*/ yang na/ slob dpon chen po ku ku ri pas mdzad pa'i shin tu spros pa med pa'i man ngag ltar nyams su blang ngo*// mdor na man ngag gi rim pa 'di rnams slob dpon ku ku ri pa dang nag po pa la sogs pa'i dbang bzhi par yang*/

dbang bzhi pa ni bla ma'i man ngag las shes par bya'o// zhes gsungs pas bla ma'i man ngag kho nas go zhing rtogs par byos shig / ces dang*/ spro na dbang bzhi pa'i don rgya cher bshad do| | des don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ ye shes kyi dri ma gzung 'dzin phra ba tshun dag /chos kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i sa bon bzhag /'bras bu ye shes rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ ji skad du/ de nas slob ma dad ldan pas// rta dang glang po shing rta dang*// srog nor rin chen sna tshogs dang*// nor bu me tog rgyan sogs pa// phyag byas bla ma dam pa la// ma zhen pa yi sems kyis dbul// zhes gsungs pa ltar yon dang gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul lo// gsum pa rjes ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa sngar bshad pa ltar rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa byas la chad lhag gi nyes pa zhi phyir yi ge brgya pa bzla/ rdor dril dang bcas skor ba lan gsum byas mthar/ shar sgor gtso bo la phyogs pas bsgrengs te/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*// ma nus pa yis chad pa 'am// gzhan yang nongs pa gang bgyis pa// thugs rje'i rang bzhin bzod par rigs// zhes bzod par gsol/ bdag gis dkyil 'khor bris pa yi// bsod nams 'di yis 'gro ba kun// sgyu 'phrul chen mo khyab bdag gi// gtso bo'i go 'phang nyid thob shog / ces sogs smon lam gdab| oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// ji lta'i rjes mthun dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra muḥ rdul tshon dang bum bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ oṃ a kā ro 'i sngags mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ muḥ zhes brjod cing chos thams cad skye ba med par bsams la/

g.yon dril bu gsil/ g.yas rdo rje'i rtse mos shar sgo nas tshangs thig gi steng du dbus kyi gtso bo'i gnas kyi bar dbyi/ dbus kyi rdul tshon cung zad rang gi spyi bor bkod/ de rjes mtha' nas dbus su bsdu/ oṃ badz+ra kī la udakī la ya sarba kī lān badz+ra dha ra ā dzñā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa hoḥ zhes skam pa'i phyag rgyas phur bu dbyung*/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa na sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa bzlas pa'i 'o mas phur bu'i dbal bkru/ phur khung dgang bgegs rnams rmas pa sos par bsam/ phur bu'i lha la mchod cing bstod la gshegs su gsol/ rdul tshon 'dod pa rnams la byin/ lhag ma bum par blugs/ glang po che'i phrag pa'am/ do li'i khrir bteg /gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ ba dan/ rol mo la sogs pa'i bsnyen bkur dang bcas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bo chen po rnams su cho ga dang bcas klu rnams kyi don du chur dor nas/ klu rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdul phra rab mgo bor bzhag ste rang gi khyim du dad pas 'gro bar bsam/ chu de nas bum pa gang khyer ba gnas khang du gtor zhing rang nyid khrus dang btung ba sogs bya/ nyi ma gsum mam bdun du dga' ston bya/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i yo byad rnams slob dpon kho nas longs spyad/ de ltar min na gtsug lag khang la sogs par dbul lo// mthar shis brjod ni/ bkra shis gang zhig khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// ye shes mkha' 'gro grub chen ku ku ri// sgyu 'phrul mnga' bdag mar ston chos blo sogs// drin can rtsa brgyud bla mas dge legs stsol// bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin// mkha' 'gro ma tshogs 'khor los sgyur ba'i gtso// thabs mchog bde chen sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i skur// bde ba mchog gi bkra shis stsol gyur cig /bkra shis gang zhig rang snang shes rab ma// stong nyid dngos grub rdzogs pa'i dgyes bde mo// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro rgyal kun skyed mdzad yum// bde ba chen po'i bkra shis stsol gyur cig

/bkra shis gang zhig sa khams rnam dag cing*| |byams pa tshad med me long ye shes rigs// rdo rje mkha' 'gro dga' ba'i rang bzhin can// bde ba mchog gi bkra shis stsol gyur cig /bkra shis gang zhig chu khams rnam dag cing*| |snying rje tshad med mnyam nyid ye shes rigs// rin chen mkha' 'gro mchog dga'i rang bzhin can// bde ba chen po'i bkra shis stsol gyur cig /bkra shis gang zhig me khams rnam dag cing*// dga' ba tshad med sor rtog ye shes rigs// pad+ma mkha' 'gro dga' bral skyed mdzad yum// bde ba mchog gi bkra shis stsol gyur cig /bkra shis gang zhig rlung khams rnam dag cing*// btang snyoms tshad med nan tan ye shes rigs// sna tshogs mkha' 'gro lhan skyes skyed mdzad yum// bde ba mchog gi bkra shis stsol gyur cig /bkra shis gang zhig rin chen gzhal med khang*// byang phyogs so bdun tshad med rdzogs pa'i khams// sna tshogs rgyan ldan mtshan nyid kun rdzogs pa// bde ba mchog gi bkra shis stsol gyur cig /bkra shis gang zhig tshogs brgyad rnam dag pa// dur khrod brgyad du phyogs skyong zhing skyong dang*// lha klu la sogs bkod pa kun bstan pa'i// bde ba mchog gi bkra shis stsol gyur cig /bkra shis gang zhig ye shes bsrung ba'i mkhar// rdo rje'i ra gur mi mthun bdud las rgyal// dus kun 'jigs pa che las sgrol mdzad pa// bde ba mchog gi bkra shis stsol gyur cig /bkra shis gang zhig dbyibs dang sngags rnal 'byor// rim gnyis zab mo'i thos bsam bsgom pa yi// dge ba mtha' yas nam mkha'i mthas klas pa// bde ba mchog gi bkra shis stsol gyur cig /bkra shis gang zhig sgyu ma'i dkyil 'khor che// bsgrubs shing skal ldan smin par bgyis pa yi// rab dkar dge ba sems can la bsngos pas// bde ba mchog gi bkra shis stsol gyur cig | ces dang gzhan yang shis brjod ci rigs par bya'o/
